thread:
irene: tiny pet drop \/ gecko edition! Noodle the leopard gecko found the coziest sticky note and refuses to move. photo: https://files.redwood.example/noodle-sticky-note.jpg 🦎💛
finn: i can't. that face + tiny toes. official morale booster. (reacted with :heart:)
sam: thermostat set to "gecko-approved" immediately. what temp is Noodle demanding? :thermometer:
leila: scientific inquiry: is the sticky note preferred substrate or is Noodle auditioning for office stationery oversight?
irene: update: Noodle definitely prefers sticky note. also performed an investigative blink when i tried to relocate him. very diplomatic.
finn: proposal: designate 2 minutes between meetings for "microgecko" check-ins. low overhead, infinite smiles.
sam: vote: heart = microgecko check-ins, clap = full gecko cameo during all-hands, laugh = send more pics instead (emoji poll)
leila: also curious if Noodle accepts applause or prefers soft jazz. we should have a preference study.
irene: bonus tidbit: Noodle has a tiny tunnel created from a paperclip and will disappear for 30s then re-emerge like a dramatic tiny hero.
giphy-bot: (posted a tiny gecko boogie gif) https://giphy.example/gecko-boogie.gif
finn: gif nailed the leg wiggle. i'm officially smiling at my desk.
sam: action item: irene to collect Noodle cameo video for Friday lunchtime show-and-tell. optional tiny sax accompaniment.
leila: i'll curate a playlist of "gentle jazz for reptiles". must contain at least one bossa nova.
irene: done. will attempt to capture dramatic re-emergence. may require bribery with crickets.
finn: bribe approved. sending virtual cricket stipend. :cricket:
sam: closing: if anyone else has tiny pet stationery habits, drop them here. my plant once colonized a highlighter.
